title: Data for the exact retraction from big to small etale sheaves
statement: For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] and the fixed universe convention [def-weil-size-convention], let $u:T_{\mathrm{Et}}\hookrightarrow(\mathrm{Sch}/T)_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be the inclusion of the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] into the big etale site $(\mathrm{Sch}/T)_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. An exact big-small etale retraction datum consists of: a geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism] $\pi_T:\mathrm{Sh}((\mathrm{Sch}/T)_{\mathrm{Et}})\to\mathrm{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{Et}})$ of sheaves of sets together with a natural isomorphism between its direct image and restriction along $u$, $(\pi_{T,*}G)(U/T)=G(U/T)$; a geometric morphism from abelian sheaves on $(\mathrm{Sch}/T)_{\mathrm{Et}}$ to abelian sheaves on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$ together with a natural isomorphism between its direct image and restriction along $u$, $(\pi_{T,*}G)(U/T)=G(U/T)$, natural in $G$ and in $U/T$; such that this abelian direct image preserves finite limits and finite colimits, and the abelian adjunction unit $F\to\pi_{T,*}\pi_T^{-1}F$ is an isomorphism for every abelian sheaf $F$ on $T_{\mathrm{Et}}$. Since both direct images are identified with restriction along $u$, the inverse images are the canonical left adjoints $u_s$ (unique up to unique isomorphism), so the datum is the one induced by the inclusion.
